entities.name: Allyl bromide
observations: Decoded as C=CCBr; acts as the allylic electrophile.
Undergoes substitution at the carbon bearing bromine.

entities.name: Hydroxy-bromobenzaldehyde
observations: Decoded as a brominated hydroxybenzaldehyde; phenolic oxygen is the nucleophilic site after deprotonation.
Retains the aryl bromine and aldehyde groups in the predicted product.

entities.name: Phenolic O-allylation
observations: Likely Williamson ether synthesis via SN2 substitution of allyl bromide by the phenoxide.

entities.name: Allyl aryl ether product
observations: The new bond is between the phenolic oxygen and the allylic carbon formerly bearing bromine.
